Merged Studio PR #95 (head a672d41; merge 86eac15, Studio CI run 34678238388 passed all six jobs) adds a committed production benchmark harness with in-page performance marks (apps/studio/src/features/benchmark/benchmark.ts, enabled by ?benchmark=<nodes>x<edges>) and the selective-rendering work it measured: unchanged flow nodes and cached edges keep object identity, React Flow handler/option identities are stable, history retains entries by reference and copies only on read, updateNode validates only the edited node, and ensureLayout no longer builds a full node+edge projection. Measured on the production build at 250 nodes / 500 edges (the harness caps at the owner's 256-node / 1024-edge per-graph limit): PERF-01 first useful render is met on chromium (508ms), firefox (936ms) and webkit (912ms) against 2000ms. PERF-02 input-to-visible-feedback p95 is met on chromium (36.9ms) and firefox (97ms, no margin) but missed on webkit (335ms) against the 100ms target; the authoritative edit handler is ~1ms on every engine, so the residual cost is engine rasterization of the 500-edge SVG layer. PERF-03/04/05/06/07/08 remain unmeasured. P2-089 stays partial until the webkit edit path meets the target; the measured bottleneck and scoped fix are recorded in docs/evidence/benchmark-results.json.
